Are You Ready To Experience The Ultimate Personalised Weight Loss Transformation At Our Stunning Luxury Weight Loss Spa?

Step into a life-changing journey with the Alive Luxury Weight Loss Retreat; a holistic fat loss and wellbeing program designed to help you rebuild confidence, restore health, and reconnect with the body you want to live in. More than a diet or fitness camp, this is a complete lifestyle transformation that works on every level — physical, emotional, and mental.

Each weight loss retreat is customised to your unique needs, focusing on safe and sustainable fat loss through science-based nutrition, gentle detoxification, fitness and hormone-balancing protocols that suit your body. Whether your goal is to overcome unhealthy habits, address weight gain, or improve energy and self-worth, our expert team designs a program specifically for your body, metabolism, and lifestyle.

Your personalised weight loss and wellness program may include nutritional weight loss menus (paleo, keto, vegan, vegetarian, or Mediterranean-inspired), natural detox methods for cleansing the body and supporting fat loss, and hormone-balancing nutrition to reset metabolism and restore energy. Guests also benefit from supportive therapies like ice baths, ocean swims, lymphatic massage, colonics, nutrient therapy, and herbal treatments that help cleanse, strengthen, and revitalise the body.

At Alive, we combine structured fitness and nutrition fat loss retreat programs with mental wellbeing practices — including yoga, meditation, healing, spa, mindfulness, and wellness coaching — to help you reset your mindset and restore your confidence. Every guest receives individual support and expert care in a nurturing, judgment-free environment that empowers lasting change.

Whether you join us in Bali, or Mexico, our luxury weight loss retreats deliver proven, sustainable results that go far beyond the scale helping you rebalance your hormones, rejuvenate your body, and rediscover your healthiest, happiest self.
